system.description:
Out of items that you can normally equip, you become able to use items with the [Light Armor] [Cloak] or [Boot] tags that have an Item Rank equal to your [CR+2] or lower.

You can apply the power of change and wear various guises that you would not normally be able to equip yourself with. It is said that you are a fox that borrows the authority of a tiger, but even if it is borrowed, it is still a force that protects you and your friends.
